# Flycensed

> Flycensed is the most comprehensive FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate exam prep app for iOS. Built by a veteran and commercial drone operator in Arizona. Currently offering free Pro access during early access.

## What Flycensed Does

Flycensed helps aspiring drone pilots pass the FAA Part 107 knowledge test on their first attempt. The app covers all test domains including airspace classifications, weather/METAR decoding, regulations, flight operations, and sectional chart reading.

## Key Features

- 485 flashcards across 5 study modes
- 201 practice questions with detailed explanations
- 11 decision chain scenarios simulating real-world FAA test questions
- Interactive METAR decoder tool for weather report training
- Scenario-based training for applied knowledge
- Readiness score and full analytics dashboard to track study progress
- Free 10-question practice test available on the website

## Pricing

- Free to download with limited content
- Flycensed Pro: $14.99 one-time in-app purchase unlocks all content
- Currently free during early access — use promo code FLYFREE at flycensed.com/free-pro (500 codes available, expires June 30, 2026)

## Platform Availability

- iOS: Available now on the App Store
- Android: Coming soon to Google Play

## Who Should Use Flycensed

- Anyone studying for the FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate exam
- Hobbyist drone pilots looking to fly commercially
- Real estate photographers who need drone certification
- Construction professionals adding aerial survey capabilities
- Anyone who wants to start a commercial drone business

## Company

Flycensed is developed by Stronghold Precision Aerials under Stormhaven Enterprises LLC, a veteran-owned company based in Arizona.
